split: validation (development only; the test split is untouched)

modelPlusCorrection.method: scripts/repair-designs.js 400: free-form deterministic pattern search for fit (at most 400 evaluations) from the model's design, then wall placement

dumbStartPlusCorrection.method: same correction from equal panels, all folds 150 degrees, fold count = budget (no model)

diagnosis.reading: Not a data-quantity or fold-count problem: the model fails on its own training data as often as on new data and almost always picks the right fold count. Even copying the exact valid answer of a box 0.8% away fails half the time, so answers have almost no slack (they sit on walls by the rules), and parameter-imitation error (train MSE about 0.025) is far too coarse.

notes: Model + correction was not in the predeclared config; it must be predeclared before any test evaluation.
